title: Lorwyn Eclipsed Commander: card flavor text

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker whose heart went out to those changed by the aurora's tides, who knows the pain of having selfhood ripped away.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: A sun-associated being whose glow and blessings Lorwyn's adherents invoke with bells and dancing.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: A moon-associated being whose adherents invoke its blessings with contemplation at standing stones.

entities.name: Lysh
entities.description: A kithkin wickersmith.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: A people of Lorwyn who hold rites in Eirdu's glow.

entities.name: Zasharua
entities.description: A Brighthearth mentor who speaks of the flamekin Path of Flame.

entities.name: Brighthearth
entities.description: A flamekin group with mentors guiding the Path of Flame.

entities.name: Geth, Lord of the Vault
entities.description: A Phyrexian-aligned lord who says Mirrodin kneels and begs for perfection.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane said to kneel and beg for perfection.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who claims to have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to raving.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian addressed by Elesh Norn about her creations.

entities.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who wishes to unite the flesh rather than merely flay it.

entities.name: Thalia, Knight-Cathar
entities.description: A knight who laments that holy places and death are no longer sanctuary.

entities.name: Nundari
entities.description: A Sea Gate militia captain who trains for the improbable.

entities.name: Sea Gate militia
entities.description: The militia of Sea Gate.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of animals communing with their environment.

entities.name: Dosan the Falling Leaf
entities.description: A speaker who says the land grows only where the kami will it.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A speaker who describes his child growing from rot and ruin.

entities.name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
entities.description: Multani's child, who bloomed from rot and ruin.

entities.name: Cevraya
entities.description: A Golgari shaman who speaks of constant decay.

entities.name: Shafring Hulm
entities.description: A beachcomber who insists something walked ashore.

entities.name: Taani
entities.description: A berserker of Etlan who had seen death before.

entities.name: Mairsil, the Pretender
entities.description: A figure who asks what others have that he cannot obtain.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer who exploited nature to power his war machines.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A being whose awakening made the temple of Alara's creatures emerge again.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane whose creatures a ziggurat was built to honor.

entities.name: Pulan
entities.description: A Bant orchardist whose trees were transformed overnight.

entities.name: Kotis, the Fangkeeper
entities.description: A speaker who calls for Qarsi's gates to be thrown open.

entities.name: Qarsi
entities.description: The former seat of oppression whose gates are to be opened.

entities.name: Gvar Barzeel
entities.description: A krumar captain who speaks of what makes a stronghold worth defending.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane of quiet, teeming places and verselets of Eirdu.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: A plane rife with wild magic, rot, slime and despair.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose defenders faced the spreading Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings that spread across Zendikar.

entities.name: Mistmeadow
entities.description: A tight-knit doun where duty outweighs death.

entities.name: Kulrath
entities.description: A blasted peak circled by mounted cinders hunting the Extinguisher.

entities.name: the Extinguisher
entities.description: A quarry hunted by mounted cinders around Kulrath.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A volcanic continent with bizarre vegetation near gas vents.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A geothermal swampland continent reeking of heat and decay.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A cruel world whose brutal struggles scar the land.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A world where awe for terrestrial gods hunts ambition and treachery nearly to extinction.

entities.name: the Conflux
entities.description: An event that crashed far-flung continents together.

entities.name: Soul Snuffers
entities.description: A group that once sought to unite with the flame of transcendence and now extinguishes the lights of others.

events.summary: Ajani felt compassion for those changed by the aurora's tides, recalling his own loss of selfhood.
events.quote: Ajani's heart went out to those changed by the aurora's tides.

events.summary: The Eldrazi spread across Zendikar and its defenders sought every advantage.
events.quote: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

events.summary: The Soul Snuffers, who once sought to unite with the flame of transcendence, turned to extinguishing others' lights.
events.quote: Now they seek only to extinguish the lights of others.

events.summary: Mounted cinders circle Kulrath, hunting the Extinguisher.
events.quote: Mounted cinders circle the blasted peak at Kulrath, hunting the Extinguisher.

events.summary: Urza's war machines were ultimately exploited by nature to renew itself.
events.quote: in time, nature exploited his war machines to renew itself.

events.summary: When Progenitus awakened, the vanished temple of Alara's creatures emerged again.
events.quote: When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

events.summary: The Conflux crashed far-flung continents together.
events.quote: The Conflux crashed together far-flung continents, like ships colliding in a storm.

events.summary: Pulan and the Bant orchardists awoke to find their trees transformed.
events.quote: When we awoke, we found our trees transformed.

relations.note: Multani speaks of Muldrotha as his child
relations.quote: My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed.

relations.note: Elesh Norn addresses Sheoldred as a fellow Phyrexian whose methods differ
relations.quote: Your creations are effective, Sheoldred, but we must unite the flesh, not merely flay it.

relations.note: Geth speaks of Mirrodin kneeling for perfection
relations.quote: Mirrodin kneels and begs us for perfection.
